name: Link Gates
bio: Link Gates killed a mountain sheep with Howard Eaton in September 1885 and bid on stock at a sale that fall. In a roping contest at Pierre Wibaux's ranch in June 1886 he placed second after his rope broke.

moments.label: Placed second in roping contest after rope broke

mentions: Several mountain sheep have been killed lately, the last lucky hunters being Howard Eaton and Link. Gates.
